# AI-Rulez

> Directory-based AI governance for 18+ tools. Define rules, context, skills, agents and commands once in `.ai-rulez/` — generate native configs for Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini, Codex, and more.

ai-rulez centralizes AI assistant instructions in a `.ai-rulez/` directory with rules, context, skills, agents, and commands. Run `ai-rulez generate` to produce tool-specific outputs for all your AI coding assistants. Supports domains for team scoping, profiles for selective generation, remote includes for sharing rules across repos, and installed skills for pulling library-specific instructions from external repositories.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/installation/): Install via Homebrew, Go, npm, or pip. Run without installing via npx or uvx.
- [Quick Start](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/quick-start/): Initialize a project, add rules and context, generate outputs in 5 minutes.

## Configuration

- [Configuration Reference](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/configuration/): Complete config.yaml reference — presets, profiles, builtins, includes, installed skills, headers.
- [Domains & Profiles](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/domains/): Organize content by team or service with domains, select subsets with profiles.
- [Includes](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/includes/): Share rules across projects via git repos or local paths with configurable merge strategies.
- [Installed Skills](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/installed-skills/): Install named skills from external repos, fetched dynamically at generate time.

## Reference

- [CLI Commands](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/cli/): All commands — init, generate, validate, domain, add/remove/list, include, skill, profile, mcp, version.
- [MCP Server](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/mcp-server/): Model Context Protocol server exposing CRUD, generate, and validate operations to AI assistants.
- [Schema](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/schema/): JSON schema validation for config.yaml and content frontmatter.

## Guides

- [Monorepo Guide](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/monorepo/): Best practices for large projects with domain-based organization.
- [Examples](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/examples/): Configuration examples for minimal, multi-team, skills-based, monorepo, and environment-specific setups.

## Optional

- [Custom Presets](https://goldziher.github.io/ai-rulez/profiles/): Create custom output formats with Go templates.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Goldziher/ai-rulez/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Goldziher/ai-rulez/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines.
